about: The camera of every frame. pos/look: map frame [X, D, H] metres (X along the scroll, D north, H up). quat: page frame (x = X, y = H, z = -D), three.js camera looking down its -z. fov: vertical, degrees. look_px: the look point in the frame, 0..1 from the top left. t: shot seconds at the frame's shutter open.
